Fredensborg is a Danish municipality included in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report serves as a vital tool for local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system, analyzing the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1]. 

Fredensborg's data specifically contributes to the calculations for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation treatment using data from the DanStroke registry [^src1]. On page 93 of the report, Fredensborg is listed in a detailed municipal breakdown, showing its performance metrics for stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients and indicating that it did not meet the target ("Nej") for this specific indicator [^src1]. 

Because the available evidence is thin, consisting of only a single tabular mention, no further details, claims, or relationships regarding Fredensborg are documented in the provided corpus.
